Business_Problem: Revenue Generated but Company Remains Unprofitable
Root_Cause: Product cost and marketing allocation consume more than total revenue before discounts, refunds, shipping and payment fees.
Recommended_Action: Reduce marketing cost, renegotiate product cost, correct loss-making prices and control discounts.

Business_Problem: Excess Inventory and Extremely Low Turnover
Root_Cause: Purchasing and replenishment are not aligned with product demand; slow products continue to receive inventory.
Recommended_Action: Stop dead-stock purchasing, liquidate excess inventory and introduce demand-based reorder points.

Root_Cause: Supplier SLA performance is weak and almost half the supplier base requires renegotiation or review.
Recommended_Action: Renegotiate low-performing suppliers, enforce SLA penalties and shift critical purchases to alternatives.

Root_Cause: Management revenue, database sales, discounts, returns, refunds and unmatched transactions use different definitions and processing rules.
Recommended_Action: Create a governed revenue definition and automate order-to-cash reconciliation before reporting.

Root_Cause: Weak collection follow-up, delayed customer payments and insufficient credit-risk controls.
Recommended_Action: Create ageing-based collection workflows, escalate high-value invoices and review customer credit limits.
